fields.missing_source_or_test: Installed Be-skin optical, mass, adhesion, aging, wet-surface and thermal-cycle evidence, including the switchable finish.
fields.detail: Sheldahl's alpha<=0.14 and epsilon<=0.05 specifications concern an aluminized polyimide film with acrylic protection. Holding 8.33 g/m2 while transferring those optics to Be is already disclosed as a projection. The numerical thermal shift is reproducible, not qualified hardware.

numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: The common equations do not qualify the bond, core law, coatings or installed safety factor. Carry the exact conventions, not an interchangeable headline. [052 disposition](unpublished-local-ref:3a70e117fbb14e85), [CHECK053](unpublished-local-ref:599d3a276c2fcbce).
